what_this_is: One row per shoe. A shoe is the 6-deck pack; it is reshuffled when the cut card is reached, roughly every 22 to 28 rounds.
read_this_first: played_to_cut_card tells you whether the shoe finished. false means the player stopped part-way through it, so that shoe is a fragment and is NOT comparable with a complete one. Mistakes are far denser in fragments, and treating the two alike has already produced one false result.
164 of 217 shoes here were played to the cut card.
Money figures are the net for that shoe in pounds.
